title: Investigating Youth’s Technical and Ethical Understanding of Generative Language Models When Engaging in Construction and Deconstruction Activities
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion. It is a study investigating how engaging young people in the design and auditing of generative language models fosters their technical and ethical understanding of these systems.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
